continuous_test.statistic: slope on Hoop G z, one per class

forecast.missing_times: linear fill from combine_weight_z, edge_share, ngs_athleticism_score

metric: Hoop G = max over the Run-the-Hoop lap of the 0.5 s rolling mean of sideways acceleration (g), mean over runs, z-scored within Combine year
shrinkage: lam = k*rel/(1+(k-1)*rel); shr = lam*z; sd = sqrt(lam*(1-lam))
